lints.name: anon_security_definer_function_executable
lints.title: Public Can Execute SECURITY DEFINER Function
lints.description: Detects `SECURITY DEFINER` functions that are callable without signing in. Revoke `EXECUTE`, switch the function to `SECURITY INVOKER`, or move it out of your exposed API schema if it is not meant to be public.

findings.detail: Function `public.create_project(_name text, _color text)` can be executed by the `anon` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/create_project`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.

Function `public.get_current_user_email()` can be executed by the `anon` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/get_current_user_email`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.

Function `public.is_project_owner(_user_id uuid, _project_id uuid)` can be executed by the `anon` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/is_project_owner`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.
